extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant can issue
extracted.summary: A solicitor administering a Harrogate estate worth around £1,053,000, mostly the deceased's home, seeks £81,000 to pay inheritance tax due by 2 October so the grant can issue.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about a probate loan in connection with the estate you are administering in Harrogate. We have noted the gross estate value of approximately £1,053,000, the £81,000 sought for inheritance tax, and the 2 October tax deadline. To take this further we would need details of the deceased, confirmation of the executors and their identification, a breakdown of the estate assets and liabilities, the IHT400 or equivalent computation, and confirmation of the property's title and any charges over it. Once we have those we can review the enquiry and come back to you.
